firm_data.firm_description: CHAU|IP is an award-winning boutique law firm that grows and protects the value of Intellectual Property assets. They specialize in AI and other technically complex expertise.
notable_facts: Ranked #1 New York Firm and #6 US Firm in Quality by IAMS
The firm has experience working on over 250 complex AI cases in the past 2 years.
The firm's goal is to reduce the risk of ineffective, narrow, or meaningless IP by thoroughly understanding all aspects of invention and applying the law through IP experts.
technology_signals: Uses proprietary software and processes in case management and patent application preparation

ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm provides guidance on how to file and protect AI IP. They have experience working on over 250 complex AI cases in the past 2 years.

email.subject: AI for CHAU|IP, built for firms handling complex IP
email.body:
Hi Frank,

Your firm's work on 250+ complex AI cases in the past two years puts you at the forefront of a practice area most firms are still figuring out. That expertise, paired with your proprietary processes, gives you a real competitive edge.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of boutique practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to show how we're helping firms like yours compete and scale without losing the quality that built your reputation.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
